# Optional Dear ImGui sources

Not bundled in this archive. From the project root, run `python3 tools/fetch_imgui.py`
explicitly, or set `QUANTA_IMGUI_DIR` to a local audited source tree.
CMake never downloads dependencies. Supported adapter version: **1.91.9b**,
commit `f5befd2d29e66809cd1110a152e375a7f1981f06`.

See [THIRD_PARTY](../../THIRD_PARTY.md) and retain the upstream LICENSE.txt when fetching.
